title: A landing line is checked by node: the work must really be on michael/dev, and today's branches audited by content

chat.text: Twice a task wrote "landed" while its code never reached michael/dev (property-of yesterday, InstanceTree today). A LandingCheck class verifies by file content, not commit count, because the merge script sometimes lands a branch by applying its diff; the landing nag and the follow-up list both use it, and every branch still ahead of michael/dev is audited once with the real misses listed for you.
